ValidationRule.description: The rule will make sure that End Date field is not null when Project Implementer field is populated for ITA Implementation Project
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ( TemplateName__c = 'ITA-Implementation' ) , ISBLANK( pse__End_Date__c ) , NOT( ISBLANK( Project_Implementer__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter the value for End Date
